what_it_does: suggests the closest known word to `word` by Norvig edit distance, preferring exact, then distance 1, then distance 2

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: same edit as `_known_edits2`.a (the distance-2 enumeration is the cost); submitted once against `_known_edits2`

what_it_does: returns the members of NWORDS that are at edit distance 2 of `word`

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: builds ~(54n+25)^2 candidate strings and tests each for membership in a ~100-word dict; testing each known word against the ~500 distance-1 strings with a direct edit-1 predicate removes the millions of string constructions

what_it_does: returns the index of the first unescaped occurrence of a char

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: backward scan visits every occurrence and slices a copy each time; a forward `find` loop returns at the first unescaped hit, and rfind with an end argument avoids the slice

what_it_does: returns the index of the last unescaped occurrence of a char

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `string[:pos].rfind(char)` allocates a copy per iteration; `string.rfind(char, 0, pos)` searches the same range without copying

what_it_does: splits a string on unescaped separators, scanning from the right

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: each piece costs a slice `string[:lastpos]` plus a fresh scan; passing an end bound to the scanner removes k slice copies of up to n chars

what_it_does: converts a stringified {$dnanexus_link: ...} to a path, else returns the path unchanged

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: every ordinary path goes through json.loads and raises JSONDecodeError, which is caught by a bare except; a leading-brace test skips the parse and the exception for strings that cannot be JSON objects

what_it_does: parses a path into (project, folder, name), calling resolver helpers

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `get_last_pos_of_char(':', path)` at the elif repeats the scan already stored in `last_colon`; replace by the variable

what_it_does: escapes control characters and backslash in one cell string

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: re.sub with a string pattern and a nested function per call; a precompiled search that returns the input unchanged when no escapable char is present avoids building the replacer and the substitution for the common case

what_it_does: renders a table of rows as a bordered, padded text table

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `len(list(table)[0])` copies the whole row list to read one row; `len(next(iter(table)))` reads it directly

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: the cost is inside escape_unicode_string, whose own repair covers it; editing here would be the same reason twice

decisions.label: c
decisions.why: `' '*n` padding vs ljust is a constant-factor tie; no mechanism

what_it_does: collapses multi-line JSON arrays of a given name onto one line

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: each pass of the while loop joins one line per array and rescans the document; a single regex pass whose callback joins all comma-terminated lines removes the repeated full-document scans

what_it_does: truncates a log message so its JSON encoding fits a datagram

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `message.encode` runs before the early return, so every message that fits pays a copy it never uses

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: the loop drops one byte and re-serialises the prefix on each pass (up to 8000 json.dumps of 8 KB for escape-heavy text); the encoded length is monotone in the prefix length so a binary search finds the same cut with ~13 serialisations

what_it_does: merges a list of ids into an existing pheno filter of a cohort

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `reduce(lambda a, b: a + [conv(b)], ...)` builds a new list per element: O(n^2). Calling the same lambda as `f([], b)[0]` per element yields the same converted value in O(n)

what_it_does: converts and validates cohort ids against the dataset via a viz query

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: same quadratic reduce over the user's id list; the same per-element `f([], b)[0]` comprehension gives an identical list

what_it_does: builds the coding dictionary DataFrame for one coding

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `display.index(c)` and `c in display` scan a list per code; a position dict built once makes each lookup O(1), keeping first-occurrence semantics via setdefault

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: each recursion level re-yields the child's tuples, so a node at depth d is passed through d generator frames; threading a result list through the recursion appends each tuple once

what_it_does: assembles entity, edge and coding frames of the data dictionary

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `source_eblock.assign(...)` copies the entire entity DataFrame per edge and the copy is discarded; the dictionary is updated through `.values` aliasing before it, so deleting the statement changes nothing observable

what_it_does: queries expression data of an assay and writes it out (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `DATASET_DESCRIPTOR` is assigned and never read; each access of descriptor_file_dict downloads, gunzips and parses the descriptor, so deleting the line removes a whole download

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: `assays_info_dict['molecular_expression']` and `assay_names_list` each re-download the descriptor on every evaluation; evaluating once into locals saves 2-3 downloads

decisions.label: c
decisions.why: `set(additional_fields)` is rebuilt for every schema column inside the comprehension

what_it_does: extracts germline variant data of an assay (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: with infer flags and a genotype_type filter that excludes the inferred type, two API queries and an O(loci*samples) list are produced and then filtered out; guard the block

what_it_does: fetches coding pages from the viz server and merges them (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: deepcopy of a freshly parsed response page that nothing else aliases; storing the page directly avoids the duplicate

what_it_does: looks up genomic bins for genes from a manifest on the platform (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: each call spawns `dx cat` and downloads and parses the full gene manifest; reading through dxpy in process and avoiding the existence-probe describe removes a process spawn per call

what_it_does: validates a user JSON filter

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: opens and parses a schema file whose result is never used (validate() is commented out); drop the read

what_it_does: builds the final extract payload and field list

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: avoiding the re-read needs a module-level cache and a defensive copy because the caller appends to the returned list; the saving is one small file open per call

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: two passes over a list of a dozen fields; negligible

what_it_does: rewrites a genotype-only SQL statement to match the union columns

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: the fix is a module-level cache which a function-only edit cannot introduce; the file is small and read at most twice per run

what_it_does: pads each result row to the full field list with None

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: two membership tests and two assignments per field per row; a dict comprehension with `.get` does one lookup per field inside the interpreter's comprehension loop

what_it_does: adds inferred ref/no-call entries for samples missing at each locus

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `loci_dict[locus]` is looked up three times per sample in the inner loop; bind it and the sample set once per locus

what_it_does: removes entries whose key value is in a restricted list

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: restricted_values holds at most a few strings, where a list scan beats building a set; and values may be unhashable

what_it_does: writes expression rows as CSV to a file or stdout

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `set(COLUMN_NAMES)` and `set(i.keys())` are built for every row, O(rows*cols) allocation; build the expected set once and compare key views

what_it_does: buffers data and dispatches upload parts

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: for data longer than the buffer each recursion slices `data[remaining_space:]`, copying the whole tail every time (O(L^2/B)); a loop over offsets copies each byte once

what_it_does: reads a byte range using prefetched chunks

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: each chunk is sliced and written to a growing BytesIO and copied again by buf.read(); collecting pieces and joining once removes the extra copies (network unit: needs a download iterator)

what_it_does: reads from the file, checking project membership first

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: merging the existence probe with the size describe changes which request fails with which exception and needs a new code path; not a small edit

what_it_does: renders the nextflow.sh template with per-input parameters

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: two strings are extended with `+=`/`+` once per custom input, copying the accumulated text each time; a list joined once is linear

what_it_does: turns nextflow_schema.json properties into dx inputs

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: step-1 suspicion bundled three reasons; split into b, c, d on the second reading

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: `property_key in required_inputs` scans a list per property; a set makes it one hash lookup

decisions.label: c
decisions.why: `inputs.insert(0, x)` is O(n) per required input; collecting required inputs in order and reversing once gives the same final order

decisions.label: d
decisions.why: two small dicts built per property is a micro-cost with no way to hoist except nested-scope changes; dominated by the JSON load

what_it_does: formats a currency value using locale

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `locale.setlocale` re-reads and re-applies the locale on every call; checking the current setting first and skipping the call when equal leaves identical process state

what_it_does: prints a project description field by field

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: turning the list into a set inside the function costs as much to build as it saves; a module-level constant is outside a function-only edit

what_it_does: creates an md5 hasher compatible with FIPS

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: on Python 3.9+ (this venv is 3.10) `usedforsecurity` is accepted and no exception is raised, so there is no waste to remove

what_it_does: lists executions and prints them as a tree (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `x not in executions_by_parent[parent]` scans a list per insert, O(k^2) for k children; tracking membership in a set keeps the list order

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: emptiness test on a key list, negligible

decisions.label: c
decisions.why: deep execution trees are rare and the dict copy is dominated by printing

what_it_does: expands batch patterns via the API and writes TSV files (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: flatten_batch sorts `b['inputs'].items()` twice per row, and `sorted(...)` of the same keys is already in `input_names`; build each row once from input_names

what_it_does: resolves a database file listing for download (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: debug strings are formatted eagerly, including the full folder listing, although the DEBUG level is never enabled (basicConfig INFO); guard formatting with isEnabledFor

what_it_does: prepares and launches `dx run` (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: deepcopy of the whole cloned job description to read one key

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: one describe round trip per workflow stage even when stages share an executable; memoise by executable id

what_it_does: streams job logs with timestamps (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: enrich_msg formats a datetime string and curses colour for every message even when timestamps are off; compute lazily

what_it_does: connects to a job by ssh (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: describe every second while a job is queued; capped backoff cuts requests and wakeups

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: describe after the ssh session whose result is only read when check_running; move it inside the condition

what_it_does: requests archival of files (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: one full-describe find_data_objects per path; request only name/id fields

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: deepcopy where a shallow copy suffices because only a top-level key is added

what_it_does: changes the working directory in the CLI (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: project describe at the top is used in one branch only; move it into the branch

what_it_does: pages through an API find method as a generator

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: after yielding exactly `limit` results the code requests the next page, which is thrown away on the next iteration; return right after the last wanted result

what_it_does: downloads a database file in chunks (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: md5 hasher updated over every byte of every chunk but never checked, since verify_part calls are commented out

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: describe call whose result variable is never read afterwards

what_it_does: returns (and caches) a download URL (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: the existence describe runs before the cache check on every chunk request; DXFile runs it only on a cache miss

what_it_does: downloads app resources and writes source (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: getmembers() decompresses the whole archive up front and each extract then seeks backwards in the gzip stream; iterating the archive lazily extracts in one pass

what_it_does: finds/creates the session config dir and cleans stale ones

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: the cleanup is requested by the caller via an argument and creates observable file removals; throttling it changes the unit's effect on the filesystem

what_it_does: curses top-like view of job metrics

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: rate-limiting redraws changes the screen output sequence; cannot be checked for identical behaviour

what_it_does: returns the region's underlying workflow handler (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: the region cache is overwritten with a single handler instead of being keyed by region, so each call re-describes; store per region

what_it_does: tars resources, checks for a bundle, uploads (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: moving the checksum pass ahead of the tar needs restructuring most of a 140-line function, not a small edit

what_it_does: looks up cached image files on the platform (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: one find_data_objects per image ref even when refs repeat the same image; search once per distinct key

what_it_does: checks stage executables share regions (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: describe calls are repeated for executables used by several stages; iterate distinct ids

what_it_does: validates a billTo (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `dxpy.whoami()` round trip precedes the branches and is unused for org billTo; move into the branch that needs it

what_it_does: merges requested cluster instance counts into app specs

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: deep-copies every entrypoint and then discards most; filter first, copy only the survivors

what_it_does: runs a local entry point and updates job_outputs.json

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: the O(jobs) re-resolution is the intended propagation of finished outputs and the unit launches subprocess jobs; no small edit preserves the written file

what_it_does: downloads files/folders (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: list_subfolders per path argument even when several share (project, parent folder); memoise per pair

what_it_does: clones objects to a new destination and renames (network)

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: each loop iteration makes a rename API call, which dominates the list scan
